title: Canonical tensor unit and Hom reindexing of native adic modules
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ and a scheme isomorphism $g:X\cong Y$, native realization tensor data of [def-sf-native-adic-realization-data] and coefficient reindexing data and exact module inverse image of [def-sf-native-adic-reindexing-data]. If $\ell$ is invertible on $X,Y$, a tensor reindexing datum consists of a cochain tensor isomorphism equal to identity on every homogeneous pure tensor, preservation of K-flat complexes, and a derived tensor isomorphism whose K-flat representative square uses that cochain map and the recorded ambient models. Include an isomorphism of the pulled-back coefficient-unit complex with the source coefficient-unit complex, equal in degree zero to the fixed coefficient map on every section. Define its derived unit map using the exact factorization and recorded degree-zero unit models. Define its ambient derived Hom map as the closed transpose of the inverse tensor comparison followed by pulled-back module evaluation. All comparisons use the actual native coefficient sheaves and ordinary module derived categories; none is an arbitrary map, and no k-linearity or existence hypothesis is imposed. These are definitions, not an assertion of existence.
